title: Bluey Biomes!!!
description: This adds a few entitys, a boss, two OP weapons, a dimension, a block and a structure, all inspired in Bluey!
body:
A simple mod **FAN-MADE** inspired on bluey.

It adds some entitys: Bluey, bingo and byrdo, a boss: tiger bingo (from _onesies_)

Also a biome and a dimension with tons of diamonds and a house where you can find bluey and bingo (but sometimes they run out of the house, so don't expect too much see them in home)
